faqs.question: How are the Channel Partner (CP) plans structured?
faqs.answer: Our CP plans are specifically tailored to the ticket size of your properties: (1) Project upto ₹80 Lakh at ₹75,000 for 3 Months, (2) Project ₹80 Lakh to ₹1.5 Cr at ₹90,000 for 3 Months, (3) Project ₹1.5 Cr to ₹3 Cr at ₹1.5 Lakh for 3 Months, and (4) Project Above ₹3 Cr & Builders at ₹2 Lakh for 3 Months. Each package gives you a dedicated 3-month growth engine.

faqs.question: What is included across all CP marketing plans?
faqs.answer: Every plan includes WhatsApp Marketing + Quality Data, AI Promotional Videos, Lead Verification & Qualification Support, Meta Ads, Google & YouTube Ads management, Project Landing Pages, Reels & Short-Form Content, Associated Channels network activation, and daily Campaign Optimization with weekly CPL reporting.

faqs.question: Does the fee include advertising budget or is it separate?
faqs.answer: The package fee covers agency execution, creative production, video generation, landing page development, tele-calling lead qualification, and strategic management for the full 3-month cycle. Ad spend (paid directly to Meta and Google) is separate so you maintain 100% control over your daily ad budget without markups.

faqs.question: How does the Associated Channels collaboration work?
faqs.answer: Through Associated Channels, we provide verified real estate marketing expertise, structured channel partner alignment, broker channel activation, and proven lead qualification funnels designed to deliver more quality leads, stronger brand presence, better project visibility, and end-to-end sales support.

faqs.question: How does the Lead Verification and Qualification support work?
faqs.answer: We ensure your sales team never wastes time on junk or fake inquiries. Our dedicated qualification team calls and WhatsApp-verifies every incoming inquiry to confirm the buyer's budget, preferred unit configuration (e.g., 2 BHK, 3 BHK, Penthouse), location interest, and buying timeframe before handing them over or booking a site visit.

faqs.question: How quickly will our campaigns and landing pages go live?
faqs.answer: We execute rapidly. Your custom project landing page, ad creatives, WhatsApp funnels, and campaigns will be fully configured and live within 5 to 7 business days from onboarding and collateral collection.

faqs.question: Do we get complete ownership of the landing page, videos, and leads?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. All landing pages, domain configurations, AI promotional videos, ad creative designs, and prospective buyer databases belong exclusively to your firm.

faqs.question: How do I get started with a Channel Partner Plan?
faqs.answer: Select your ticket-size plan from the grid, click 'Select Plan & Buy Now' to initiate onboarding online, message us on WhatsApp, or call our team directly at 9096090701. We will schedule a kickoff session within 24 hours.
